## How was it tested?

- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test`
- [ ] Checked in the studio (`pnpm dev`) — screenshots or a short clip for visual changes
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` if the change touches the studio shell, saving or export

## Checklist

- [ ] New assets are CC0 or OFL/compatible and listed in `ASSETS.md`
- [ ] No code, assets, presets, templates or copy taken from other products
- [ ] Schema changes are additive, or come with a migration and a test
- [ ] `ROADMAP.md` updated if this completes a roadmap item
